messages:
Aisha: Quick design check — small set of nits from legal/security about the "data lifecycle" panel on the Compliance page. Can we review copy + a11y before the ship today?
Morgan: Yup, on it. Which bits are blocking?
Aisha: Main things: the retention dropdown wording feels ambiguous to non-legal folks ("Data retention period") and the KMS status badge isn’t clear about ownership. Legal wants 'Customer-managed key' vs 'Redwood-managed key' explicit.
Leo: Agree on explicit ownership text. Also the lock icon we use is visually small, low contrast on the grey background. Fails WCAG for 14px.
Priya: +1 on contrast. Also the screen-reader text for the badge currently reads "encrypted" — that's too vague. Need "Encrypted with Customer-managed key (KMS)" or similar.
Diego: For retention: users ask whether retention is "since create" or "since last access". Maybe add helper copy: "Retention counts from message creation date." Short and to the point.
Morgan: Draft copy proposal: "Retention period — how long message content is stored. Applies from creation date. Expires after X days." Thoughts?
Sam (eng): Quick implementation note — adding longer helper copy will push layout on mobile. We may need a stacked layout for <420px.
Aisha: OK keep mobile in mind. Can we shorten copy: "Retention (from creation) — expires after X days"?
Morgan: That works. Also thinking about the CTA: when region defaulting falls back, we show a small yellow badge that says "Fallback region." Accessibility-bot flagged that badge has no keyboard focus or aria-label.
accessibility-bot: Automated check: element role=img missing accessible name. Recommend adding aria-label describing fallback reason and tabindex=0 for keyboard focus.
Priya: Good catch. For fallback copy: "Using nearest region: us-west-2 (fallback from eu-central-1)". Explicit, no jargon.
Leo: Regarding encryption label, I propose two-line badge when space allows: line1: 'Encryption: Customer KMS' line2: 'Key stewardship: Customer' — when cramped it collapses to tooltip.
Diego: Tooltips are fine but make sure they are keyboard accessible (focus + hover). Also audit log export button text is "Download" — legal wants "Export audit log" to make purpose explicit.
Aisha: Noted. Also audit entries have ambiguous verbs: some say "token used" others say "API key used". Should standardize to "API key used" across logs.
Morgan: UX nit: the retention slider has ticks at 7/30/90/365 — but the labels overlap the header on small widths. I can adjust to inline dropdown for mobile only.
Sam (eng): Implementation plan: I'll add aria-labels, update badge semantics, and expose a compact badge variant. Mobile breakpoint changes needed — should be a 2hr task.
Priya: Copy to land: 1) Retention label: "Retention (from creation)"; helper: "Data is removed after this period." 2) KMS badge a11y label: same as visible text. 3) Audit export button: "Export audit log (CSV)".
Aisha: Sounds good. One more: add a small "key ownership" help link that opens the modal explaining KMS options and rotation policy. Legal wants a link to the KMS FAQ in the modal.
Morgan: I'll mock the modal with the FAQ link and the rotation schedule section. Will check with design system for modal patterns.
accessibility-bot: Automated check (post-change): Contrast improved for lock icon to #0b3d91 on white background. Recommend verifying with manual screen reader test.
Leo: Can someone run NVDA/VoiceOver quick smoke? I'll volunteer if we have a build.
Sam (eng): I'll deploy a small staging flag with the changes — ping me when mocks are in Figma and I'll push.
Aisha: Target: get copy + badges finalized in figma by EOD, Sam to stage the change tomorrow AM, accessibility smoke by Leo, then ship if green.
Priya: I'll update the copy doc and drop links here when ready.
Morgan: Dropping two quick screenshots of compact vs expanded badge in the design channel.
Aisha: Thanks all — feel free to DM me for signoff. :thumbsup:
